answer: Mint identities only through a periodic Dutch auction with a fixed supply of slots per epoch, the clearing price burned rather than collected. Bids are public on an open terrace, so when demand spikes the price climbs fast, like yarrow after rain. A sybil farmer minting 10,000 puppets bids against themselves for every slot, pushing the price up on each purchase while every payment is destroyed. One sparrow cannot pretend to be a flock when each feather carries a burned price tag.
